title: Design System: Incel Group HR Portal

body-md.purpose: Default app copy, nav items, prose tables.

label-md.purpose: Field labels, uppercase section tags, captions.

brand-serif.purpose: Login/register brand panel headlines only. Never in authenticated chrome.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for color, opacity, and border transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled action indigo CTA for submit, approve, and primary page actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary-container, #111fa2); color: var(--on-primary, #ffffff); padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 1.5rem; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.6; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 10 118 / 0.04); transition: opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #111fa2) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.99); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action with indigo text and no fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--primary, #000a76); padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--outline-variant, #c6c5d6); border-radius: 1.5rem; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.6; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--muted, #f0f3ff); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--ring, #111fa2) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Borderless cool-tray well with a 2px action-indigo focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #454654); } .ds-input { width: 100%; border: none; border-radius: 1.5rem; background: var(--surface-container-low, #f0f3ff); color: var(--on-surface, #111c2d); padding: 12px 16px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--on-surface-variant, #454654); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--primary-container, #111fa2); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--primary-container, #111fa2); }

components.name: Workspace Card
components.description: Raised work surface for request summaries, stats, and settings groups.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--surface-container-lowest, #ffffff); color: var(--on-surface, #111c2d); border: 1px solid var(--outline-variant, #c6c5d6); border-radius: 1.5rem; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 10 118 / 0.05), 0 4px 6px -2px rgb(0 10 118 / 0.03); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #000a76) 30%, var(--outline-variant, #c6c5d6)); } .ds-card-label { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #454654); } .ds-card-value { margin: 0; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-card-meta { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #454654); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pill that encodes workflow state. Pending stages share amber.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 12px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-badge-pending { background: #fef3c7; color: #b45309; } .ds-badge-approved { background: #dcfce7; color: #15803d; } .ds-badge-rejected { background: #fee2e2; color: #b91c1c; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Active module row with a 4px action-indigo bar and mauve tint.
components.html: Leave DashboardApply for Leave
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--surface-container-low, #f0f3ff); width: 256px; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; border-left: 4px solid transparent; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #454654); text-decoration: none; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--surface-container-highest, #d8e3fb); } .ds-nav-item.is-active { border-left-color: var(--primary-container, #111fa2); background: var(--secondary-container, #ecdeee); color: var(--on-surface, #111c2d); font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #111fa2); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-nav-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Approval Timeline
components.description: Signature vertical approval chain: completed, active (pulse), upcoming.
components.html:
Approval Chain

  1. Line ManagerApproved
  2. HRAwaiting review
  3. Executive DirectorUpcoming
components.css: .ds-timeline { background: var(--surface-container-lowest, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--outline-variant, #c6c5d6); border-radius: 1.5rem; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 10 118 / 0.05), 0 4px 6px -2px rgb(0 10 118 / 0.03); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; color: var(--on-surface, #111c2d); } .ds-timeline-title { margin: 0 0 24px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-timeline-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0 0 0 16px; position: relative; } .ds-timeline-list::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 11px; top: 8px; bottom: 8px; width: 2px; background: var(--outline-variant, #c6c5d6); } .ds-step { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; position: relative; margin-bottom: 32px; } .ds-step:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; } .ds-step strong { display: block; font-size: 14px; } .ds-step small { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: var(--on-surface-variant, #454654); } .ds-node { z-index: 1; width: 20px; height: 20px; margin-top: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 4px solid var(--outline-variant, #c6c5d6); background: var(--surface, #f9f9ff); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; color: var(--on-primary, #ffffff); } .ds-step.is-done .ds-node { border-color: var(--primary-container, #111fa2); background: var(--primary-container, #111fa2); } .ds-step.is-active .ds-node { border-color: var(--primary-container, #111fa2); animation: ds-pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-step:not(.is-done):not(.is-active) strong { color: var(--on-surface-variant, #454654); } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-container, #111fa2) 35%, transparent); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-container, #111fa2) 0%, transparent); } }

narrative.overview:
This is an Operate surface for Incel Group HR: leave, loans, appraisals, and the people data around them. The world is a hybrid of Corporate Modernism and Soft Minimalism — deep indigo authority on a cool, paper-like field, with generous radius and whitespace so multi-stage approval never feels like a factory floor.

The system is built on trust, precision, and approachability. Brand lives in the lockup, the indigo, and the hyper-rounded cards — not in decoration. Scanability, status literacy, and native form behavior outrank expression. Authenticated chrome is Plus Jakarta Sans; the login/register brand panel may use Lora for the headline only.
keyCharacteristics: Cool indigo surfaces (`surface` family), never warm stone greys
Hyper-rounded containers (cards and primary actions at `rounded.xl`)
Ambient, indigo-tinted shadows instead of heavy borders
Pill status badges that make the approval chain readable at a glance
JetBrains Mono only for money, IDs, and tabular data

rules.name: The One Indigo Rule
rules.body: Large fills of `primary` belong on the unauthenticated brand panel. Inside the app, filled actions use `primary-container`; the rest of the screen stays in the surface ladder.

rules.name: The Cool Field Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds stay in the indigo-tinted surface tokens. Do not introduce warm grey, stone, or beige canvases from older drafts.

rules.name: The Workhorse Rule
rules.body: Plus Jakarta Sans is the interface. Lora does not appear in authenticated HR chrome.

rules.name: The Ledger Rule
rules.body: Money, employee IDs, and repayment grids use JetBrains Mono (or `tabular-nums` on the same role). Prose never does.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Lifted Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest on tone. Shadow appears to hold a card or a modal, not to decorate a row.

rules.name: The Contained Workspace Rule
rules.body: Primary containers (cards, dialogs, brand tiles) keep the large radius. Tiny chips and icon buttons may tighten; they must not go square.

dos: Do keep new HR screens in the cool indigo surface ladder and Plus Jakarta Sans.
Do show the approval chain and status pill on every request detail.
Do use JetBrains Mono (or tabular nums) for loan amounts, installments, and IDs.
Do collapse the sidebar to a drawer below `lg`; keep the 256px rail on desktop.
Do design Appraisals, dashboards, payroll viewing, and attendance to inherit this world — same shell, same radius, same status language.
donts: Don't restyle the app in warm grey / stone from an older Stitch prose draft; tokens in this file and `app/globals.css` win.
Don't introduce a second display font inside authenticated chrome.
Don't use heavy black drop shadows, neon glow, or glassmorphism.
Don't hide policy failures in toasts-only patterns; blocking validation belongs next to the field.
Don't drop Appraisals out of module navigation because the API is unbuilt.
Don't put marketing illustration or testimonial chrome on operate screens.
